stories.title: ‘No bandwidth left for the family’: why many Singaporeans want to be child-free
stories.summary: As Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong prepares to unveil plans to ease the strain on families during his National Day Rally speech on Sunday, a new survey points to a difficult question behind the city state’s record-low fertility rate: what if a substantial share of residents no longer want children at all?
